29571-nan-of-music-mountain.title: Music Mountain
29571-nan-of-music-mountain.creator: Unknown
29571-nan-of-music-mountain.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Lefever, if there was a table in the room, could never be got to sit on a chair; and being rotund he sat preferably sidewise on the edge of the table. One of his small feet--his feet were encased in tight, high-heeled, ill-fitting horsemen's boots--usually rested on the floor, the other swung at the end of his stubby leg slowly in the air.

arxiv-1405-4442.title: Lepton Flavor Violation in the Standard Model with dimension 6 operators
arxiv-1405-4442.creator: Saereh Najjari
arxiv-1405-4442.description: Abstract We investigate Lepton Flavor Violation (LFV) in the general extension of the Standard Model parametrized by the gauge invariant operators of dimension-6. We discuss 3-body charged lepton decays and decay of Z boson to lepton pair and compare the obtained analytical expression with the current experimental results.

arxiv-1608-01185.title: Stable Galerkin Finite Element Scheme for the Simulation of Problems Involving Conductors Moving Rectilinearly in Magnetic Fields
arxiv-1608-01185.creator: Sethupathy Subramanian, Udaya Kumar
arxiv-1608-01185.description: A 2016 arXiv research paper by Sethupathy Subramanian, Udaya Kumar. For the simulation of rectilinearly moving conductors across a magnetic field, the Galer-kin finite element method (GFEM) is generally employed. The inherent instability of GFEM is very often addressed by employing Streamline upwinding/Petrov-Galerkin (SU/PG) scheme. However, the SU/PG solution is known to suffer from distortion at the boundary transverse to the velocity and the remedial measures suggested in fluid dynamics literature are computationally demanding. Therefore, simple alternative schemes are essential.

arxiv-2308-00784.title: Achromatic rapid flares in hard X-rays in the γ \gamma -ray binary LS I +61 303 2023 Achromatic rapid flares in hard X-rays in the γ \gamma -ray binary LS I +61 303 – References
arxiv-2308-00784.creator: Enzo A. Saavedra, Gustavo E. Romero, Valenti Bosch-Ramon, Elina Kefala
arxiv-2308-00784.description: Abstract We report on the presence of very rapid hard X-ray variability in the γ \gamma -ray binary LS I +61 303. The results were obtained by analysing NuSTAR data, which show two achromatic strong flares on ks time-scales before apastron.

arxiv-2308-08375.title: A new understanding of grazing limit
arxiv-2308-08375.creator: Tong Yang, Yu-long Zhou
arxiv-2308-08375.description: Abstract . The grazing limit of the Boltzmann equation to Landau equation is well-known and has been justified by using cutoff near the grazing angle with some suitable scaling. In this paper, we will provide a new understanding by simply applying a natural scaling on the Boltzmann operator without angular cutoff.

How Bursty Star Formation and Patchy Dust Can Cause Temporary Quiescence in High Redshift Galaxies Facilities: JWST astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) ; DELightcurveSimulation ( Connolly 2016 ) ; FSPS ( Conroy et al. 2009 ; Conroy & Gunn
arxiv-2402-13316.creator: Andreas L. Faisst, Takahiro Morishita
arxiv-2402-13316.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Andreas L. Faisst, Takahiro Morishita. The recent discovery of a galaxy at z = 7.3 z=7.3 with undetected optical emission lines and a blue UV to optical continuum ratio in JWST spectroscopy is surprising and needs to be explained physically.

arxiv-2405-11861.title: Separability and lower bounds of quantum entanglement based on realignment
arxiv-2405-11861.creator: Jiaxin Sun, 1 Hongmei Yao, 1,∗ Shao-Ming Fei, 2,† and Zhaobing Fan 1
arxiv-2405-11861.description: Abstract The detection and estimation of quantum entanglement are the essential issues in the theory of quantum entanglement. We construct matrices based on the realignment of density matrices and the vectorization of the reduced density matrices, from which a family of separability criteria are presented for both bipartite and multipartite systems.

arxiv-2502-06456.title: A scaling invariance of the perturbations in k k -inflation models
arxiv-2502-06456.creator: Neven Bilić, Dragoljub D. Dimitrijević, Goran S. Djordjevic, Milan Milošević, Marko Stojanović
arxiv-2502-06456.description: Abstract We study the background and perturbations in k k -essence inflation models and show that a general k k -essence exhibits a simple scaling property. In particular, we study two classes of k k -inflation models with the potential characterized by an inflection point.

arxiv-2503-18919.title: κ \kappa -Entanglement Entropy from Black Hole
arxiv-2503-18919.creator: Fabiano F. Santos, Ankit Anand
arxiv-2503-18919.description: Abstract In this work, we explore the entanglement entropy equipped with the κ \kappa -algebra. This entanglement entropy is computed through the geometric setup as performed by Hartman-Maldacena, which, in their prescription, finds that the entropy grows linearly in time.

arxiv-2503-21447.title: Quantisations of exactly solvable ghostly models
arxiv-2503-21447.creator: Andreas Fring ∙, Takano Taira ∘, Bethan Turner ∙
arxiv-2503-21447.description: Abstract We investigate an exactly solvable two-dimensional Lorentzian coupled quantum system that in a certain parameter regime can be transformed to a higher time derivative theory (HTDT) with preserved symplectic structure. By transforming the system’s Lagrangian, we explicitly map it onto the standard Pais-Uhlenbeck formulation, revealing a direct correspondence in their dynamical and Poisson bracket structures.

pmc-11406726.title: Gibberellin 2-oxidase 1(CsGA2ox1) involved gibberellin biosynthesis regulates sprouting time in camellia sinensis
pmc-11406726.creator: Ziyuan Qiu, Wenhui Guo, Qian Yu, Dongxue Li, Mengjie Zhao, Han Lv, Xuewen Hua, Yu Wang, Qingping Ma, Zhaotang Ding
pmc-11406726.description: BackgroundTea is an important cash crop and buds are its main product. To elucidate the molecular mechanism of the sprouting time of tea plants, ‘Yuchunzao’, which was an early sprouting tea cultivar, was studied. ‘Echa 1’, sprout one week later than ‘Yuchunzao’ in spring, was used as the control.

pmc-12564128.title: Systematic Review of Variable Selection Bias in Species Distribution Models for Aedes vexans (Diptera: Culicidae)
pmc-12564128.creator: Peter Pothmann, Helge Kampen, Doreen Werner, Hans-Hermann Thulke, Thomas Walker
pmc-12564128.description: Simple SummaryThe mosquito Aedes vexans is common in Europe and often appears in large numbers after floods. Because it can transmit diseases, scientists use computer models to predict where it might occur. These models rely on environmental factors such as temperature, rainfall, and land use to describe the conditions that make habitats suitable for the species.

pmc-13100817.title: Implementing the screening for poverty and related social determinants and intervening to improve knowledge of and links to resources (SPARK) in primary care clinics across Canada
pmc-13100817.creator: Leanne Kosowan, Joseph J O’Rourke, Dana Howse, Lane Williams, Itunuoluwa Adekoya, Abigail Zita Seshie, Alannah Delahunty-Pike, Mélanie Ann Smithman, Alan Katz, Eunice Abaga, Alexander Zsager, Jane Cooney, Marjeiry Robinson, Dorothy Mary Senior, Kris Aubrey-Bassler, Emily Gard Marshall, Cory Neudorf,
pmc-13100817.description: BackgroundRoutine systematic collection of social determinants data can inform improvements to health service delivery and system and policy planning.ObjectiveThis cohort study reports on the implementation of the SPARK tool to collect and integrate demographic and social needs data in primary care.MethodsThe 20-question SPARK tool was implemented from September 2022 to October 2023 at five primary care clinics.

pmc-13170906.title: Sexual and bowel function in women with obstetric anal sphincter injuries after perineoplasty and sphincterorrhaphy
pmc-13170906.creator: Efriyan Imantika, Raden K. Praharsini, Raden MS. Sasotya, Eppy D. Ahmad, Muhammad R. Arev, Andi Rinaldi, Ariass Prasetya
pmc-13170906.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASIS) may lead to persistent sexual and bowel dysfunction, even after surgical repair. Evidence on the functional outcomes after sphincterorrhaphy and perineoplasty remains limited, particularly in Indonesia. The aim of this study was to analyze the associations of perineal muscle strength and anal sphincter tone with sexual and bowel function in women with OASIS after sphincterorrhaphy and perineoplasty. This cross-sectional study was conducted at Hasan Sadikin Hospital, Bandung, Indonesia.

pmc-13178304.title: Diagnostic value of subtraction CT in evaluating the efficacy of transcatheter arterial chemoembolization-treated hepatocellular carcinoma patients compared to conventional CT and MRI
pmc-13178304.creator: Fucheng Ding, Feng Duan, Mingyang Mao, Wei Liu, Hongmei Zou, Zhuangfei Ma, Fengxian Hu
pmc-13178304.description: BackgroundTranscatheter arterial chemoembolization (TACE) is a first-line treatment for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). However, the evaluation of tumor viability after treatment with conventional computed tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is often hampered by iodized oil-induced artifacts. Subtraction CT may improve visualization by removing high-density materials.

pmc-13549393.title: Mapping the Inflammation Research Landscape in Myocardial Infarction, 1995-2025: A Bibliometric Analysis of WoSCC and PubMed
pmc-13549393.creator: Yang Liu, Sicheng Chen, Ting Li, Yang Hu, Zongrong Lin, Yiming Fu, Zhenyang Fu
pmc-13549393.description: PurposeInflammation contributes to coronary plaque instability, myocardial injury, tissue repair, ventricular remodeling, recurrent cardiovascular events, and heart failure after myocardial infarction. This study aimed to map the publication patterns, conceptual structure, and thematic evolution of myocardial infarction-related inflammation research from 1995 to 2025.

pmc-13566390.title: Prognostic Factors in Cochlear Implant in Otosclerosis: Radiologic and Clinical Variables
pmc-13566390.creator: Giulia Zambonini, Sara Ghiselli, Giuseppe Di Trapani, Daria Salsi, Domenico Cuda
pmc-13566390.description: Objective:This study aimed to determine whether radiologic and clinical data can predict the cochlear implant (CI) benefit in patients with otosclerosis, with a focus on the prognostic value of computed tomography (CT) features and relevant clinical variables.Methods:A retrospective single-centre analysis was conducted on 126 otosclerotic patients (143 implanted ears) who underwent CI between 2009 and May 2025.

pmc-13614956.title: Peripartum hypophosphatemia is associated with a hindgut-centered microbiota-metabolite-host axis in transition dairy cows
pmc-13614956.creator: J. Yuan, X. Y. Zhang, S. Yang, C. L. Luo, Z. H. Wang, Q. Q. Wang, Y. Y. Hao, Y. He, S. Wang, F. L. Kong, M. Zhao, Z. J. Cao, S. L. Li, W. Wang
pmc-13614956.description: The transition period in dairy cows is accompanied by profound shifts in mineral homeostasis and gut microbial ecology. While endocrine regulation of hypocalcemia has been extensively characterized, adaptive responses to hypophosphatemia-and the potential involvement of the gut microbiota-have received far less attention. Twenty-four Holstein dairy cows were randomly assigned to control or low-phosphorus groups.
